MLLR.description: Moving Load Reduction (MLLR). Defines a moving-load reduction factor and which internal force components it is applied to. To use any /DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/* endpoint, first activate the AIJ-ASD02 design code with PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. FACTOR outside [0.3, 1.0] is rejected with an error. If COMPONENTS is omitted on PUT, all three component flags are reset to false.

FACTOR.description: Reduction Factor applied to moving-load results. Must be between 0.3 and 1.0 (hard-validated by the handler).

COMPONENTS.description: Applied Components. Selects which internal force components the reduction factor is applied to. If omitted on PUT, all components are set to false.
